Travel-time grid to each Cornwall GP practice

Source: R/data_cornwall.R
cornwall_gp_travel.Rd

Motorised travel time in whole minutes from every populated cell of cornwall_pop.tif to each of the 55 practices, one layer per practice. The GeoTIFF is bundled in inst/extdata; load it with read_spax_example("cornwall_gp_travel.tif"), which restores the layer names from cornwall_gp_travel_names.rds.

Format

A 55-layer GeoTIFF on the cornwall_pop.tif grid (132 rows x 271 columns, EPSG:4326). Layer names are practice codes (cornwall_gp$practice). Values are rounded to whole minutes with a 1-minute floor; NA marks unpopulated cells, pairs without a road connection (mainland cells to the Isles of Scilly practice and back, and off-island Scilly cells that cannot reach the St Mary's practice) and journeys over 180 minutes.

Source

Derived from the Malaria Atlas Project motorised friction surface (Weiss et al. 2020, Creative Commons Attribution) and cornwall_gp. See system.file("COPYRIGHTS", package = "spax").

Details

Computed as for cornwall_travel; see its details for method and limitations.

References

Weiss, D. J., Nelson, A., Vargas-Ruiz, C. A., et al. (2020). Global maps of travel time to healthcare facilities. Nature Medicine, 26, 1835-1838. doi:10.1038/s41591-020-1059-1

See also

cornwall_travel, cornwall_pop

Examples

travel <- read_spax_example("cornwall_gp_travel.tif")
travel
#> class       : SpatRaster
#> size        : 132, 271, 55  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
#> resolution  : 0.008333333, 0.008333333  (x, y)
#> extent      : -6.40125, -4.142917, 49.85792, 50.95792  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> coord. ref. : lon/lat WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)
#> source      : cornwall_gp_travel.tif
#> names       : L82001, L82003, L82004, L82006, L82007, L82008, ...
#> min values  :      1,      1,      1,      1,      1,      1, ...
#> max values  :     89,     99,     91,    100,    107,    132, ...
